claim: Apple's fiscal 2025 revenue of $416.2 billion was generated in the fourth quarter.
summary: Apple's full-year fiscal 2025 revenue was about $416.2 billion, but that amount was not generated in Q4 alone. Q4 FY2025 revenue was about $102.5 billion; $416.2 billion is the sum of all four quarters.

sub_claims.text: Apple's fiscal 2025 full-year total revenue was $416.2 billion
sub_claims.note: Consistent with Apple's reported FY2025 results: Q1 ~$124.3B + Q2 ~$95.4B + Q3 ~$94.0B + Q4 ~$102.5B = ~$416.2B full-year total.

sub_claims.text: The $416.2 billion fiscal 2025 revenue was generated in the fourth quarter (i.e., Q4 FY2025 revenue was $416.2 billion)
sub_claims.stated_text: was generated in the fourth quarter
sub_claims.note: Apple's Q4 FY2025 (quarter ended Sept 27, 2025) revenue was about $102.5 billion, not $416.2 billion; $416.2 billion is the full-year aggregate, not the quarterly amount.
